page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Printed page number "59" at the head, centred. Gathering signature "D 4" at the foot, right of centre. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.

page.notes: The Greek phrases on the last lines of the page are small and partly blurred. ὀρθοδοξεῖν πρὸς τὸ τέλος and ὁ λογικὸν are my best reading; the accents and breathings are uncertain, so they are marked [?]. The Greek ἀπλῶς is read with reasonable confidence. Long s was normalised to s throughout, per the house rules (e.g. "eft" as "est", "Conftitutio" as "Constitutio"). The u/v spelling was normalised (e.g. "priuatus" as "privatus", "vt" as "ut"). No printing errors were identified.
